name: LEGEND-1000
full_name: Large Enriched Germanium Experiment for Neutrinoless double-beta Decay - LEGEND-1000
summary: LEGEND-1000 is a tonne-scale germanium-76 neutrinoless double-beta-decay proposal. It extends the low-background germanium and liquid-argon methods tested by GERDA, Majorana and LEGEND-200.
detection_principle: Enriched germanium crystals provide precise calorimetry inside liquid argon. The larger design relies on radiopure materials, pulse-shape rejection and argon scintillation detection to reduce backgrounds over a long exposure.

status.label: Planned
status.evidence: The design report describes the tonne-scale concept and projected sensitivity; it does not establish a completed detector.

key_parameters.name: Sensitivity class
key_parameters.value: 10^28-year half-life scale; forecast, not a measured limit

results.summary: The design report describes the tonne-scale concept and projected sensitivity; it does not establish a completed detector.

science_scope: A neutrinoless double-beta-decay signal would establish lepton-number violation. Converting a half-life constraint into an effective Majorana mass requires a decay mechanism and nuclear matrix elements; a null search is not a neutrino-mass measurement.
